"""Split a bill between friends, tip included."""


def ask_number(prompt, default):
    text = input(f"{prompt} [{default}]: ").strip()
    return float(text) if text else default


def main():
    bill = ask_number("Bill total", 50.0)
    tip_percent = ask_number("Tip %", 18.0)
    people = max(1, int(ask_number("How many people", 2)))
    tip = bill * tip_percent / 100
    total = bill + tip
    print(f"\nTip:        ${tip:,.2f}")
    print(f"Total:      ${total:,.2f}")
    print(f"Per person: ${total / people:,.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt, ValueError):
        print("\nBye!")

"""Read sales.csv and summarize it. Edit sales.csv and run again."""
import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

FILE = Path(__file__).with_name("sales.csv")


def load():
    with FILE.open(newline="") as f:
        return [{**row, "units": int(row["units"]), "price": float(row["price"])} for row in csv.DictReader(f)]


def main():
    rows = load()
    by_product, by_month = defaultdict(float), defaultdict(float)
    for r in rows:
        revenue = r["units"] * r["price"]
        by_product[r["product"]] += revenue
        by_month[r["month"]] += revenue
    total = sum(by_product.values())
    print(f"{len(rows)} sales, ${total:,.2f} total, ${total / len(rows):,.2f} average\n")
    print("By product:")
    for product, revenue in sorted(by_product.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]):
        print(f"  {product:<10} ${revenue:>9,.2f}  {revenue / total:>5.1%}")
    print("\nBy month:")
    top = max(by_month.values())
    for month, revenue in by_month.items():
        print(f"  {month:<4} {'█' * round(24 * revenue / top)} ${revenue:,.0f}")
    print("\nBest seller:", max(by_product, key=by_product.get))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Notes stored in a SQLite database (notes.db). Shows CREATE, INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE."""
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

DB = Path(__file__).with_name("notes.db")


def connect():
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    con.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT, pinned INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)""")
    return con


def show(con, where="1", args=()):
    for row in con.execute(f"SELECT * FROM notes WHERE {where} ORDER BY pinned DESC, id", args):
        print(f"{'📌' if row['pinned'] else '  '} #{row['id']} {row['title']}: {row['body']}")


def main():
    con = connect()
    if con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes").fetchone()[0] == 0:
        con.executemany("INSERT INTO notes (title, body) VALUES (?, ?)",
                        [("Shopping", "mangoes, limes"), ("Idea", "an app that waters plants"), ("Todo", "learn SQL joins")])
    con.execute("UPDATE notes SET pinned = 1 WHERE title = ?", ("Idea",))
    con.commit()
    print("All notes:")
    show(con)
    print("\nSearch for 'sql':")
    show(con, "title LIKE ? OR body LIKE ?", ("%sql%", "%sql%"))
    print("\nCount:", con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes").fetchone()[0])
    con.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Parse a web server log with regular expressions and summarize it."""
import re
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

LINE = re.compile(r'(?P<ip>\S+) \[(?P<time>[^\]]+)\] "(?P<method>\w+) (?P<path>\S+)" (?P<status>\d{3}) (?P<ms>\d+)ms')


def parse(text):
    return [m.groupdict() for m in map(LINE.match, text.splitlines()) if m]


def main():
    rows = parse(Path(__file__).with_name("server.log").read_text())
    print(f"{len(rows)} requests\n")
    print("Status codes:", dict(Counter(r["status"] for r in rows)))
    print("Top pages:   ", Counter(r["path"] for r in rows).most_common(3))
    print("Busiest IPs: ", Counter(r["ip"] for r in rows).most_common(2))
    errors = [r for r in rows if r["status"].startswith("5")]
    print(f"\n{len(errors)} server errors:")
    for r in errors:
        print(f"  {r['time']}  {r['method']} {r['path']}  from {r['ip']}")
    slowest = max(rows, key=lambda r: int(r["ms"]))
    print(f"\nSlowest: {slowest['path']} took {slowest['ms']}ms")
    print(f"Average: {sum(int(r['ms']) for r in rows) / len(rows):.0f}ms")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

name: Async Tasks (asyncio)
summary: Run several slow jobs at once instead of one after another.

files.main.py:
"""asyncio runs waiting jobs side by side. Three 'downloads' finish in the time of the longest one."""
import asyncio
import time


async def download(name, seconds):
    print(f"  start  {name}")
    await asyncio.sleep(seconds)
    print(f"  finish {name} after {seconds}s")
    return f"{name}.zip"


async def one_by_one(jobs):
    return [await download(name, s) for name, s in jobs]


async def all_at_once(jobs):
    return await asyncio.gather(*(download(name, s) for name, s in jobs))


async def main():
    jobs = [("photos", 0.6), ("music", 0.4), ("docs", 0.2)]
    for label, runner in (("One by one", one_by_one), ("All at once", all_at_once)):
        print(label)
        start = time.perf_counter()
        files = await runner(jobs)
        print(f"  got {files} in {time.perf_counter() - start:.1f}s\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""Lists, dictionaries, sets and comprehensions on one page."""

PEOPLE = [
    {"name": "Ada", "age": 36, "city": "London"},
    {"name": "Linus", "age": 28, "city": "Helsinki"},
    {"name": "Grace", "age": 45, "city": "New York"},
    {"name": "Alan", "age": 41, "city": "London"},
]


def main():
    names = [p["name"] for p in PEOPLE]
    print("Names:", names)
    print("Over 40:", [p["name"] for p in PEOPLE if p["age"] > 40])
    print("Age by name:", {p["name"]: p["age"] for p in PEOPLE})
    print("Cities (no repeats):", sorted({p["city"] for p in PEOPLE}))
    print("Oldest:", max(PEOPLE, key=lambda p: p["age"])["name"])
    print("Average age:", sum(p["age"] for p in PEOPLE) / len(PEOPLE))

    by_city = {}
    for p in PEOPLE:
        by_city.setdefault(p["city"], []).append(p["name"])
    print("Grouped by city:", by_city)

    print("Sorted by age:", [p["name"] for p in sorted(PEOPLE, key=lambda p: p["age"])])
    print("Slices:", names[:2], names[-1], names[::-1])
    print("Pairs:", list(zip(names, range(1, 5))))
    print("Any under 30?", any(p["age"] < 30 for p in PEOPLE), "| All adults?", all(p["age"] >= 18 for p in PEOPLE))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Ask a public web API for data with nothing but the standard library."""
import json
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

URL = "https://api.github.com/repos/python/cpython"


def fetch_json(url, timeout=8):
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "MangoIDE-template"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
        return json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))


def main():
    print("Asking", URL)
    try:
        repo = fetch_json(URL)
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ValueError) as e:
        print("Couldn't reach the internet from here:", e)
        print("The code is right; it needs a connection where it runs.")
        return
    print(f"{repo['full_name']}: {repo['description']}")
    print(f"⭐ {repo['stargazers_count']:,} stars, {repo['forks_count']:,} forks, {repo['open_issues_count']:,} open issues")
    print("Main language:", repo["language"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Run this file to test the lending rules."""
import unittest

from library.models import Book, Member
from library.service import Library, LendingError


class LibraryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.lib = Library()
        self.lib.add_book(Book("Dune", "Frank Herbert"))

    def test_lend_and_return(self):
        ada = Member("Ada")
        self.lib.lend("Dune", ada)
        self.assertFalse(self.lib.books["Dune"].available)
        self.lib.give_back("Dune")
        self.assertEqual(ada.books, [])

    def test_cannot_lend_twice(self):
        self.lib.lend("Dune", Member("Ada"))
        with self.assertRaises(LendingError):
            self.lib.lend("Dune", Member("Bob"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
